restrictedProcess: Restricted: only the subjects below get the listed rights, plus administrators and the owner. Auditors can always read.
restrictedPlatform: Restricted: only the subjects below get the listed rights, plus administrators. Auditors can always read.
defaultsProcess: Default role rights apply (e.g. designers edit & run, operators run, approvers decide, viewers read). Add entries to restrict access to specific users, teams or roles.
defaultsPlatform: Default role rights apply (e.g. designers and operators may use it, only administrators manage it). Add entries to restrict access to specific users, teams or roles.
ownerHint: The owner always has all rights on this process.
noEntries: No entries – default role rights apply.

help.view: See the process and its runs
help.run: Start and schedule runs, make selection decisions
help.manage: Change access, archive (processes) · change configuration, credentials and access, write calls in the explorer (platforms)
help.use: Use the platform in runs and schedules, read-only explorer calls
help.acknowledge: Acknowledge problems and plan maintenance windows (monitors)

restrictedMonitor: Restricted: only the subjects below get the listed rights, plus administrators and the owner. Auditors can always read.
defaultsMonitor: Default role rights apply (e.g. designers edit, operators acknowledge, everyone else reads). Add entries to restrict access to specific users, teams or roles.
ownerHintMonitor: The owner always has all rights on this monitor and is notified about it.
